name: Kuro Bitch Gyaru ga Kimo Ota ni Ochiru Made ~Kankin Ryoujoku Haishin Nikki~
original_name: 黒ビッチギャルがキモオタに堕ちるまで～監禁凌辱配信日記～
source:
Shimomura Kouta, a popular steamer with no experience with women, encounters Higashiyama Azusa in public, accompanied by an older man. Later, after discovering that she is a runaway girl involved in a prostitution scam who stole a man's wallet and escaped, Kouta decides to take matters into his own hands and abduct her. Azusa finds herself confined in an apartment, enduring a series of humiliating experiences that are shamelessly broadcasted on adult websites.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset_break/B009/01_top.html]official site[/url]]
